I have also been to this establishment for dinner with a couple of my friends eating family style and everything we had was rather tasty. Although the decor is outdated and reminds me of a stereotypical 80s Chinese restaurant, what they lack in decor they make up for in service. Their staff is friendly, patient, and kind. They even recognized my friends since they've been there a few times now, which is always a plus. Only disappointment for me is their lack of Cantonese style chow mein and chow fun.

message.content: I ate dinner here family-style with two friends, and all the food tasted good. The decor is outdated and looks like a cliché 1980s Chinese restaurant, but the excellent service compensates for this. The staff is friendly, patient, and kind. They recognized my friends, who are repeat customers, which was a nice touch. My only disappointment is that they do not serve Cantonese-style chow mein or chow fun.
